- The main article is titled **“How to Get Free SHEIN Products”**, with introductory text about SHEIN’s official reviewer program and product-testing opportunities.
- A centered prompt says **“One last question and we will show you how!”** and asks how the user prefers to receive free items. Two large green buttons are labeled **“Store pickup”** and **“Home delivery.”**

- Visible article text explains that selected users may test clothing, shoes, accessories, and other products, and emphasizes that selection is **“never guaranteed.”**

- Ads are visible near the top: one for Slack saying **“All your tools, together”** with a **“SIGN UP”** button, and a Capital One Shopping ad saying **“Coupon codes found!”** with an **“Apply Codes”** button.
- The page uses a narrow centered content column with substantial white space and a vertical scrollbar on the right.
